notes.title: Left By Angels – Now Available on Steam!
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Left By Angels[/b] is officially [b]released and available on Steam[/b]![/p][p]Step into a hauntingly beautiful world where mystery, emotion, and survival intertwine. [b]Left By Angels[/b] is a narrative-driven adventure that blends exploration, atmospheric storytelling, and immersive gameplay into a uniquely crafted experience.[/p][h3]🕊️ About the Game:[/h3][p]In a world scarred by loss and isolation, you awaken with fragmented memories and a single purpose: uncover the truth behind what was lost… and what was left behind.[/p][list][*][p]🌠 [b]Rich, emotional storytelling[/b] that will keep you guessing[/p][/*][*][p]🧩 [b]Thought-provoking puzzles[/b] and environmental challenges[/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ [b]Stylized visuals and immersive sound design[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🎵 [b]Original soundtrack[/b] tailored to the mood of every moment[/p][/*][*][p]💀 Choices that shape your journey and reveal hidden layers of the story[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you're a fan of indie narratives, atmospheric exploration, or deep emotional journeys, [b]Left By Angels[/b] offers a memorable ride through shadows, silence, and hope.[/p][h3]🚀 Get It Now:[/h3][p]The wait is over—[b]Left By Angels[/b] is ready for you to experience. Play it today and discover what truly remains when everything else fades.[/p][p]👉 [url="#"]Play Left By Angels on Steam now[/url][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who supported the game’s development. We can’t wait to hear what you think—share your experiences, leave a review, and help us spread the word![/p]

notes.content:

Play the new game from Street Art Studio by Stefan Zet for FREE!

notes.title: About chapter 2 and the early-access release.
notes.content:
Chapter 2 will be located exactly in the Hoia Baciu Forest, round glade(Poiana Rotunda) and will be based on the story of Emil Barnea that made a picture of an UFO. I will try to make something different then first chapter and make something interesting and cool with a good story. Chapter 2 will stick to the adventure-story based.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412900/d5fabd990c290fa30f869c05e786442c8019cd2e.png[/img]

Let's talk about early-access.

I know chapter 1 has some issues, I don't really know why is crashing this never happened to me.
[u]Remember that 1 person is working at this game.[/u]
This game is in early-access because I need to see peoples reactions, reviews and interact with them,
so everything you see it can be changed, that means I can erase the first chapter because I know it's not good. I hurried to launch this game because that's what I wanted and I'm trying to make a start for this game to which I want to add a lot of content.
I've seen some reviews with no sense and no feedback, just insulting or something else so [u]please be kind[/u] and remember that I am working alone at this and try to make an enjoyable game!
